extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: What matters most to you — keeping your doctors, or the lowest premium?
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, including delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment before scheduling the appointment. The customer was kept informed and the appointment was scheduled for 4 days later.
composition.coaching_note: Great job, Marcus! You followed all the necessary steps and kept the customer informed. One improvement would be to ensure the customer has a clear understanding of the plans by summarizing the key points of each plan before moving on to the next one.

crm_record.next_step: Review and confirm plan options with the customer
